question: When is the EIA application due?
expected: New applications are due February 19, 2025, February 19, 2026 and February 19, 2027, by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization. A letter of intent is requested 30 days before the due date but is not required.
quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

question: What's the max budget per year?
expected: Applications may request up to $700,000 in direct costs per year, for a project period of up to seven years; NHLBI sets the final amount commensurate with the PD/PI's current NHLBI support.
quote: Applications may request up to $700,000 direct costs per year.

question: Do I need a letter from my institution?
expected: Yes. The application must include a Letter of Support from the institution's Authorized Organization Representative (AOR), no longer than 2 pages; applications missing it will not be reviewed.
quote: Applications that are missing a Letter of Support will not be reviewed. The Letter of Support must not exceed 2 pages in length.
